name: topic_merge
description: Oracle starts with an over-fragmented clustering (k=7) and progressively merges related topic clusters down to a cleaner set. Tests that merge operations fire correctly and coherence improves.

oracle_turns.raw_text: There are too many clusters. The two smallest ones both seem to be about electronics — merge them into a single 'Electronics Reviews' cluster.
I also see two clusters that are both about music: one for albums and one for concerts. Combine them into one 'Music Reviews' cluster.
The book cluster and the film cluster are both about entertainment media. Merge them into 'Books and Films'.
That looks much cleaner. The remaining clusters now have clear, distinct themes. I'm happy with this — no further changes needed.
